notes:
The credit at the end of a chapter no longer gets read out loud. On Infinite Gacha the last thing you heard was the studio's sign-off; now the chapter just ends.

Status windows are skipped instead of read as a sentence. A stat block like "strength: 14/14 intelligence: 10/10" is a table, and spoken aloud it was the worst line in the chapter. System messages still read — "[Skill] [Stealth] acquired!" is the story happening, and you should hear it.

Characters no longer change voice partway through a chapter. If the neural voice had to fall back mid-session, the reader kept handing out character voices that fallback can't produce, so the same person could come back sounding like someone else.

Chapters you've already read will re-read their pages once to pick this up.
